summary: Owner feedback round: the hover preview now scrolls the whole abstract and stays open while the pointer is inside it; the detail page (and library entries) embed an inline PDF preview via GET /api/pdf/view with POST /api/pdf/prepare to fetch open-access PDFs; recommendation reasons are now specific (nearest reference by name + shared topic terms + OpenAlex topic, stored as papers.topic with an additive migration); 以后再看/没空/看不懂 removed from the UI, leaving only 收藏 and 不感兴趣.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 6352768. db/service/server + static UI + tests; one arXiv PDF fetched (open access).

budget_impact.rationale: Feature/UI work only; no model call and no budget or provider change. PDFs are fetched from the public arXiv open-access endpoint.
budget_impact.before: Hover preview truncated and could not scroll; detail showed only the abstract; every card had the same reason; five feedback buttons.
budget_impact.after: Scrollable preview card; inline PDF preview in detail/library; per-card reasons naming the nearest seed/saved paper and shared terms; two actions only.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: 5/5 distinct reasons; prepare ok; view returns application/pdf starting %PDF-; detail has_pdf true

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; feature work, not recommendation quality

open_risks: PDF preview is limited to open-access arXiv papers.
papers.topic is only filled for newly fetched rows; older rows fall back to similarity-only reasons.
Hover-preview timing is heuristic and visually unverified by the agent.
Recommendation quality remains unproven; gates stay not_run.
